title: Scoped ordinary Browser event metadata
description: Closed payloads for exactly the 53 Section 15 required Browser event types. Authoritative ordinary Browser transitions only; references do not admit physical owner-record storage, prove a runtime producer, serialize browser content, generate UsageRecords or attach prompt context. The EventRecord envelope remains separately owned.

workspace_created.description: A new ordinary workspace identity is committed after permission and scope admission.

workspace_reset.description: The exact workspace reset commits a new owner generation and invalidates prior page/controller projections.

workspace_closed.description: Workspace closure is confirmed; UI disappearance or a close request alone is insufficient.

page_created.description: A new page is bound to its exact ordinary workspace and initial page generation.

page_activated.description: Explicit page activation commits the selected page identity without retargeting another page.

page_closed.description: The exact page is closed and its mutation authority is no longer usable.

controller_lease_granted.description: A fenced ordinary-page lease grant commits the exact holder, generation, and epoch.

controller_lease_renewed.description: The same current holder renews the exact lease under generation/epoch CAS.

controller_lease_lost.description: The owner fences a lost or expired lease; no further action is authorized by the old fence.

controller_lease_takeover_requested.description: An explicit takeover request is recorded without granting the requester mutation authority.

controller_lease_takeover_completed.description: The old holder is fenced and the new exact holder/epoch is committed.

navigation_generation_changed.description: Navigation commits a new page generation; stale action/representation identities are rejected.

document_generation_changed.description: A document change advances the page generation and invalidates prior representation identities.

representation_captured.description: A bounded representation is produced for an exact page generation with explicit coverage.

representation_delta_created.description: A bounded delta is produced against an admitted current base representation.

representation_queried.description: A bounded local query completes against the admitted page-generation index.

representation_invalidated.description: A specific representation becomes invalid and cannot be presented as current.

script_compile_started.description: A bounded compile request enters the compiler; no browser or ProgramWorkspace effect has begun.

script_compiled.description: Compilation passes parse/type/name/effect/capability/permission/limit preflight and yields the hashed program.

script_compile_failed.description: Compilation fails with typed diagnostics and no browser, file, process, lease, capture, or workspace effect.

execution_strategy_selected.description: The owner selects requested/effective strategy from current capability, permission, and budget evidence.

execution_strategy_fallback_selected.description: A disclosed authorized fallback is selected without widening source, target, capture, or permission.

program_started.description: A preflighted program starts with current subject, workspace revision, lease, and budgets.

program_checkpointed.description: A durable checkpoint records completed effects, pending segments, workspace revision, and finalized artifacts.

program_paused.description: Pause reaches a safe owned boundary and preserves completed effects and pending continuation.

program_resumed.description: The same program resumes only after current checkpoint, permission, target, and generation revalidation.

program_completed.description: The owner records completed program execution; this is not a test verdict.

program_failed.description: The owner records failure with no-effect or reconciled-effect disposition and safe next action.

program_cancelled.description: Cancellation is confirmed at a safe boundary with completed effects and artifact finalization retained.

program_segment_started.description: A dependency-admitted bounded segment starts at its exact expected ProgramWorkspace revision.

program_segment_checkpointed.description: A segment checkpoint commits its effect/workspace boundary and continuation reference.

program_segment_completed.description: The segment completes with an explicit resulting workspace revision and completed-action identities.

program_segment_failed.description: The segment fails with typed no-effect or reconciled-effect disposition and retry safety.

program_segment_timed_out.description: The segment reaches its time budget and records stopped, reconciled, or unknown effects explicitly.

program_timeout_stopped.description: Timeout cleanup confirms stopped effects; completed work and captures remain attributable.

program_timeout_effects_reconciled.description: Timeout effects are explicitly reconciled before any policy permits a retry.

program_timeout_effect_state_unknown.description: Timeout leaves effect state unknown and retry is prohibited pending explicit reconciliation.

program_workspace_created.description: A typed durable ProgramWorkspace is created without materializing a host directory.

program_workspace_updated.description: A permitted bounded local operation CAS-commits a new workspace revision.

program_workspace_checkpointed.description: A durable workspace checkpoint commits the exact current revision and reference set.

program_workspace_spilled.description: Large typed values spill through authorized artifact/storage ownership with bounded references.

program_workspace_closed.description: The exact workspace closes after required checkpoint/artifact disposition is recorded.

screenshot_model_attachment_selected.description: A screenshot attachment choice passes permission, redaction, capability, and model-output budget policy.

screenshot_skipped.description: Model screenshot attachment is skipped for an explicit policy/capability/budget/result reason.

route_fetch_selected.description: Public static content selects the authorized Search/Fetch/Site Reader route before browser escalation.

route_browser_escalated.description: An explicit authorized need escalates the same source to Browser without hidden authority widening.

routine_generated.description: A versioned provenance-bearing routine is generated only after a validated task result.

routine_validated.description: Declared fixtures validate the exact routine/API/capability hashes without claiming empirical savings.

routine_promoted.description: Explicit promotion admits the exact scoped, reversible, validated routine version.

routine_invalidated.description: API, capability, fixture, policy, or provenance drift invalidates the exact routine version.

routine_disabled.description: The exact routine is disabled with an explicit reason and no implied permission change.

session_reconstructed_on_host.description: After source fencing and effect reconciliation, state is reconstructed on the authorized target Host; no live process migrates.

session_interrupted.description: The session is interrupted with explicit effect/recovery state; no automatic success or unsafe replay follows.
